features.name: latent_base_and_taps
features.scope: server-owned temporary output, explicit token IDs, per-layer/per-span last/mean/raw vectors

features.name: fast_prefill
features.scope: observer on actual batched prompt prefill; explicit verify diagnostic path remains

features.name: shared_lease_and_GEN_BGEN_MTP_isolation
features.scope: one latent at a time, supported fast readout shares chat read lease; no BGEN admission; legacy exclusive; request-local MTP disable; callbacks removed by RAII

features.name: official_adapt_capability
features.scope: batch>0 and batch_groups<=2; no adapt=0/0 prerequisite; capability is not numerical compatibility

features.name: unified_auth
features.scope: latent and chat use the same Strata API-key gate; unset key permits both; no diagnostic-only key

features.name: input_and_allocation_guards
features.scope: control-character/path/shape/layer-alias/span/pool checks, bounded staging scratch, 1GiB raw-row budget, per-layer coverage, finite/truncated output rejection; not a full security audit

features.name: session_KV_retention
features.scope: longest common prefix affinity and trimmed leading idle rows with corrected global slot mapping; interior holes at groups>2 remain an upstream limitation

provenance.method: one consolidated Git-format diff from the exact clean pinned upstream blobs to the final cached six-file implementation; no mixed-version prerequisite patches
provenance.baseline_validation: 3177 cached upstream blobs verified; tree and original commit objects SHA-matched; upstream BAT files normalized to Git LF only for blob reconstruction
provenance.patch_target_validation: all six target byte hashes recorded; server is the unified-auth + KV-retention implementation, generator includes official-adapt + KV-retention; remaining four are the reviewed fast-prefill/tap sources
provenance.compatibility: UNCERTIFIED: this is a source/build artifact, not a numerical certificate, deployment receipt, or reproduction of any historical binary/config identity

build_recipe.note: Single complete configure recipe used by verify.py and reproduce-build.sh. Compile-only PASS is not binary equivalence; optional comparison requires entire-file byte identity. No model execution, installation or service restart.
build_recipe.ggml_tree_digest_algorithm: sorted POSIX relative path + NUL + file SHA256 + LF, UTF-8; all regular files under ggml/; see evidence/existing-build-audit-v2-20261020.json.gz

retirement_reason: previous mixed custom/0.1.41 chain lacked base routes, fast prefill, isolation, adapt capability and auth; do not apply old patches before or after this patch

acceptance.current_tool_validation: evidence/validation-strict-tooling-linux-v2-20261020.json; build_status=NOT_RUN is not a new compile
acceptance.strict_binary_comparison: evidence/existing-build-summary-v2-20261020.json; both existing rebuilds FAIL entire-file identity; no CUDA/data equivalence inferred
acceptance.retired_comparison_claim: evidence/reproducible-build-20261020.json is preserved historical evidence only; its normalized-host same-build/equivalence criterion is withdrawn by evidence/strict-build-correction-20261020.json
